scope: Conservative first production route; explicit solver(cmg) retains the 64-column nuisance capability.

observed_guardrails_at_n100k.short_panel_rejection: T=2 was up to 13.1x slower; T=3 and T=5 cells were mixed or too close to freeze.
observed_guardrails_at_n100k.nuisance_rejection: At T=10, 32 and 64 nuisance columns were 2.58x to 4.98x slower; 8 columns was not a stable win at eight threads.
observed_guardrails_at_n100k.balanced_core_rejection: At a 5:1 core-cardinality ratio, T=10 CMG ranged from 1.01x to 1.17x slower in the guardrail cells.
observed_guardrails_at_n100k.selected_region: At T=10 or T=20 with 20:1 or 100:1 core cardinalities and no nuisance block, CMG won all calibrated unit/weighted and narrow/wide guardrail cells admitted by the rule.

qualification_status: route_frozen; full cross-platform release qualification remains separate
